integrity: All coefficients follow from a disjoint extremal-empty classification and a two-color inclusion-exclusion derivation. Supporting tests are finite, not an infinite proof. Direct antecedents cover minimum-weight constraints and complete bipartite examples; inaccessible and unindexed literature remains a novelty risk.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple connected bipartite chain graphs; exactly two distinguished colors; ordinary 2-rainbow domination; no extension to other bipartite graphs or total rainbow domination. Exhaustive computational checks stop at eight vertices.
title: Full 2-rainbow domination polynomial of connected chain graphs by extremal empty labels
